crossRefs.note: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live…
“I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was…
Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he…
“For, behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, as grain is sifted in a sieve…
All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’

parallels.note: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:

translations.web: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
translations.bsb: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
translations.kjv: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
translations.asv: and I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;
